subject.title: [Feature]: bearer token authentication for proxy servers

question: What mobile reverse-proxy transport-auth contract should OpenClaw support across setup codes, Android, iOS/macOS, and OIDC before accepting partial implementations?
rationale: The issue asks mobile clients to store and send credentials before Gateway auth runs, and current partial PRs show security and sibling-surface gaps that automation cannot settle without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt a shared secure contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design item, require wss-only or equivalent safeguards for credentials, define setup-code metadata, and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98677 as one Basic-auth slice.

options.title: Narrow to Basic auth only
options.body: Split bearer/header/cookie/OIDC into follow-up issues and accept only a smaller Basic-auth mobile contract after proof and security review.

options.title: Decline core mobile proxy auth
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers prefer users to rely on WebChat, Tailscale/VPN, or external proxy/VPN configuration instead of adding native credential surfaces.

recommendation.title: Adopt a shared secure contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design item, require wss-only or equivalent safeguards for credentials, define setup-code metadata, and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98677 as one Basic-auth slice.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision sits at the auth/setup/security contract boundary where steipete has recent setup-auth and gateway recovery history, while platform owners can review the per-app slices.
